youtube.baslik: Your ear gets ba, your eye gets ga: what do you hear? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In 1976, McGurk and MacDonald played the syllable ba to the ear while showing a face saying ga on the screen. Most listeners said they heard neither ba nor ga, but da, a syllable in between. Even when the person knows it is an illusion, the percept does not change; this effect shows that the brain decodes speech by using hearing and vision together.
